spec_match.rationale: The 17 standard indices and their roles match the Gamepad spec's Standard Gamepad mapping, and the classification story (standard/trackpad/non-standard, no vendor names exposed) matches the explainer's goals and non-goals.

interactive.rationale: 19 selectable cards (native buttons with aria-pressed) update a live detail panel with index, role, type value, and rationale.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises an interactive index reference plus the trackpad story; the page delivers both.

edge_cases.rationale: The two dashed beyond-standard cards cover the non-standardized touchpad index and the generic extra-button case, including the fingerprinting non-goal.

references.rationale: Feature index cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5075054393163776; page links the spec's remapping section.

conformance.rationale: The atlas illustrates exactly the enum contract the suite asserts (vocabulary + trackpad uniqueness), keeping page and suite aligned.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CDP run: selected cards 17 (trackpad) and 6 (standard); detail panel and aria-pressed states updated correctly; zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes; screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: gpbt-atlas-select assert fires per selection with the chosen index and type.

design_system.rationale: Selected cards invert background AND color (including the nested index span); type values use accent colours on paper (AA); dashed borders mark non-standard entries.

accessibility.rationale: Cards are native buttons in a labelled group with aria-pressed state; ≥44px min-height tap targets; detail panel is aria-live; keyboard operability is native.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: auto-fill minmax grid reflows from 4 columns to 2 on mobile; 0px overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×2000.

guidanceConsulted.query: interactive svg diagram keyboard accessible selection
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Prefer native interactive elements over SVG hit-areas so keyboard and AT support come for free.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The atlas is a grid of native <button>s with aria-pressed instead of an SVG image map; selection is fully keyboard-operable.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use auto-fill/minmax grids and keep tap targets at ≥44px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Grid is repeat(auto-fill, minmax(9.5rem,1fr)) with min-height:44px buttons; verified 0px overflow at 360px.

summary: Verified headlessly (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): card selection drives the detail panel with correct aria-pressed bookkeeping on Chromium 141 at both viewports, console clean. Content cross-checked against the spec's standard mapping and the explainer's enum table.
